learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the importance of water, discover how big village tanks are made, and understand why saving water is super important for everyone!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In many villages, people build huge open tanks to collect rainwater. It looks like a giant swimming pool that gives water to the whole village.
Building a big tank is not a one-person job. The entire village comes together, works hard, and digs the ground to make it.
The story teaches us that water is very precious. When we save water in tanks during the rainy season, we can use it when it gets hot and dry.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Be a Water Saver
fun_activity.instructions: Place a bucket under a leaking tap or outside during the rain to collect water. Use this saved water for your home plants!

quick_recap: ⭐ Village tanks are very big and collect rainwater for everyone to use.
⭐ People work together as a team to build these large tanks.
⭐ Saving water is a superpower that helps the earth stay green and happy.
